children: British listed company Satsuma Technology has sold its entire Bitcoin reserve of 669.4867 BTC, with the transactions completed from July 24 to 31 at a net average price of 47,667 pounds per coin, generating total proceeds of about 31.91 million pounds. According to ChainCatcher, the company also received approval from the U.K. High Court to carry out a capital reduction by canceling Class B shares.
The company will return 30.718881 million pounds to eligible shareholders, equal to 0.002734 pounds per Class B share.

title: Satsuma Technology Sells All Bitcoin Holdings and Wins Court Approval for Capital Reduction
